subject: Expansion: additional projects & API keys for BlueForge Health — rollout & term adjustments
messages:
From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@blueforgehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — new projects & API keys

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the great kickoff last week. We're ready to expand Redwood across a few more product teams. High level: 4 new projects (clinical-search, patient-insights, intake-forms, notifications), roughly 8 additional API keys (staging + prod per project), and we'd like to increase committed capacity from 50 to 120 concurrent token streams during business hours.

Two asks to start:
- Can you send an updated quote and any term options (annual vs monthly committed pricing)?
- We need a rollout plan and an MRP (mutual rollout plan) that shows staging keys and timeline so our infra team can schedule key provisioning.

I've attached a short scope doc with our requested projects (blueforge_requested_scope.pdf). Procurement will join this thread shortly.

Best,
Sarah Turner
Director of Engineering
BlueForge Health

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@blueforgehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — new projects & API keys

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the scope doc. We're excited to expand with BlueForge.

Short answer: yes, we can support the four projects and provisioning pattern you described. Next steps from our side:
- I will circulate an updated pricing sheet and two term options (monthly on-demand vs 12-month committed) by EOD tomorrow.
- Laura (CSM) will draft a mutual action / rollout plan with staging keys and a recommended three-week staged rollout.
- Neha (security) will confirm the SOC2 evidence and KMS options for BYOK if you require HSM/KMS integration.

Can you confirm the target go-live for production across all teams (end of August or later)? That'll help us size the onboarding cadence.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Team — looping you in to price and operationalize BlueForge's request (see Sarah's note below). Key constraints: 4 projects, 8 new keys, need 120 concurrent token streams (business hrs), target prod go-live: ~2026-08-29 (tentative).

Marcus: can you run committed pricing scenarios (12-month commit) with a step-up plan? They are current monthly customers on the hosted plan and we should show them savings for committing to a larger pool and a short-term onboarding discount.

Neha: confirm what artifacts we can provide (SOC2 report, pen-test summary) and what the BYOK timeline looks like if they request KMS.

Thanks — Kim

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Pricing & capacity for BlueForge expansion

Kimberly / team — attached is a pricing matrix (pricing_v3.xlsx) with three options:
1) Monthly on-demand (no commit) — baseline unit pricing, higher per-token.
2) 12-month committed capacity (recommended) — commit to 120 concurrent streams with 20% discount and API-key bundling; includes staging keys at no extra charge.
3) 12-month + onboarding credit — same as #2 plus a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 10% of first-month usage) for fast rollout.

Notes:
- If BlueForge agrees to a 12-month commit we can offer a 18% net discount if they sign within 14 days (sales-stretch concession).
- We should scope a small pilot (two projects) to validate prefix caching gains before full roll-out.

I'll defer the final SOW language to legal, but this gives us numbers to put in the MRP.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Attachment: pricing_v3.xlsx (Excel, 3 sheets)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@blueforgehealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft mutual action plan & rollout schedule (BlueForge)

Hi Sarah — please find a draft mutual action plan and staged rollout schedule attached (mutual_action_plan.xlsx). Key highlights:

Week 0 (alignment): finalize projects list & procurement items
Week 1 (staging): provision 2 staging keys per project, infra validation, test prompts and prefix caching
Week 2 (pilot): onboard two projects to prod low-volume, monitor latency/cost metrics
Week 3 (ramp): move remaining projects to prod keys, full capacity enabled

Staging keys: we'll send a CSV with staging key ids for your infra team to whitelist (staging_keys_list.csv).
Responsibilities:
- BlueForge infra: whitelist IP ranges, perform smoke tests on staging keys
- Redwood: provide SOC2 artifacts, assist with KMS options, supply onboarding engineer for the pilot week

Open questions for procurement: preferred term (monthly vs 12-month), PO timing, and whether they require a formal SOW.

Looking forward to your feedback.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, staging_keys_list.csv
